items.title: 23.6 Relative Acidities of Carboxylic Acids (carboxylic acids ki acidity ka muqabla) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 23.6 with Quick Check 23.4 (answers need review), printed pages 108-109 (PDF 111-112).

blocks.text: Carboxylic acids phenols se kaafi zyada acidic hain, aur phenols alcohols se bhi zyada acidic hain. Carboxylic acid, phenol aur alcohol ke acidity constant ya ionization constant, Ka, ki relative (ek doosre ke muqable mein) values neeche table mein hain.
Kisi acid ki strength (taqat), yani woh kitna ionize hota hai (H⁺ deta hai), us ke conjugate base (H⁺ nikalne ke baad bachne wala ion) ki stability (mazbooti) par depend karti hai. Maslan:

blocks.alt: Ethanoic acid, CH3-C(=O)-O-H (O par -delta, H par +delta), equilibrium mein (arrows par H2O) ethanoate ion, CH3-C(=O)-O-, + H+ ke saath. Ka = 1.8 x 10^-5; pKa = 4.76.
blocks.caption: Ethanoic acid ki ionisation (kitab ke page 112 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: pKa = –log Ka
blocks.text: Ka jitna zyada, ya pKa jitna kam, acid utna strong; aur iske ulat bhi.

Ethanoate ion (conjugate base) mein electrons ke delocalization (phail jane) ki wajah se oxygen atom par negative charge ki intensity (shiddat) kam ho jati hai. Is se ethanoate ion stable ho jata hai aur H⁺ ion le kar wapas acid molecule banane par kam tayyar hota hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke electrons '–COOH group' ke ird gird delocalised hain. Ethanoate ion mein –COOH nahi balke –COO⁻ group hai; electrons is ke carbon aur dono oxygen atoms par phail jate hain.

blocks.alt: Ethanoate ion ki do resonance structures, double-headed arrow se jure: CH3-C(=O)-O- aur CH3-C(-O-)=O. Curly arrows dikhate hain ke C=O ke pi electrons aik oxygen par jate hain aur O- ka lone pair wapas C-O bond mein aata hai.
blocks.caption: Ethanoate ion mein negative charge ka delocalisation (phailao) (kitab ke page 112 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Curly arrows (mure hue teer) electrons ki movement (harkat) dikhate hain: aik oxygen ka negative charge C–O bond mein aa kar double bond banata hai aur C=O ke π electrons doosre oxygen par chale jate hain. Dono structures barabar hain, yani negative charge dono oxygens mein bat jata hai aur ion stable (mustahkam) ho jata hai.

Electron dene wala group (+I effect) carboxylate ion ka negative charge barha kar use unstable karta hai aur acid ki acidity kam kar deta hai. Doosri taraf electron kheenchne wala group (–I effect) negative charge ko phaila kar carboxylate ion ko stable karta hai aur acidity barha deta hai. Maslan methanoic acid ethanoic acid se 10 guna strong acid hai.

blocks.alt: H-COOH, H peele box mein, neeche arrow '(-I effect)' tak; Ka = 1.8 x 10^-4, pKa = 3.75. CH3-COOH, CH3 box mein, neeche arrow '(+I effect)' tak; Ka = 1.8 x 10^-5, pKa = 4.75.
blocks.caption: Methanoic acid aur ethanoic acid ka comparison (muqabla) (kitab ke page 112 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: CH₃ group electrons ko carboxylate ki taraf dhakelta hai (+I effect), negative charge barh jata hai aur ethanoic acid weak (kamzor) ho jata hai. Methanoic acid mein CH₃ ki jagah sirf H hai, is liye yeh taqriban 10 guna strong hai (Ka 10⁻⁴ vs 10⁻⁵).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke labels '(-1 effect)' aur '(+1 effect)' hain; yahan 1 nahi balke harf I (inductive effect) hai: –I aur +I. Kitab H ko '–I' bhi likhti hai; asal mein H inductive effect ka reference (maayar) hai aur us ka koi –I effect nahi. Methanoic acid is liye strong hai ke ethanoic acid ke CH₃ group ka +I effect hai.

Maslan chloroacetic acid (ClCH₂–COOH) ka pKa 2.86 hai, yani yeh ethanoic acid (pKa = 4.74) se strong hai. Dichloroethanoic acid (Cl₂CH–COOH) aur bhi strong hai, pKa 1.26. Trichloroacetic acid (Cl₃C–COOH) ka pKa 0.64 hai, jo kuch mineral acids ke barabar hai.

blocks.alt: Acetic acid (pKa = 4.74), chloroacetic acid (2.86), dichloroacetic acid (1.26) aur trichloroacetic acid (0.64) ki displayed formulas (khule structures): CH3 wale carbon ke aik, do aur teen H ki jagah Cl. Gulabi mota arrow daen taraf: 'Stronger acid'.
blocks.caption: Acetic acid aur us ke chlorine wale acids (kitab ke page 112 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har Cl atom electrons apni taraf kheenchta hai (–I effect) aur carboxylate ion ka negative charge phaila deta hai. Is liye jitne zyada Cl, utna stable ion aur utna strong acid: pKa 4.74 se 0.64 tak girta hai.

blocks.prompt: a) Methanoic acid ethanoic acid se strong hai. Wajah batayein.
blocks.explanation: Ethanoic acid ka methyl group COO⁻ ki taraf electrons dhakelta hai (+I effect), negative charge barhata hai aur ethanoate ion ko unstable karta hai. Methanoate mein sirf H hai, is liye us ka ion zyada stable hai aur methanoic acid zyada ionize hota hai.

blocks.prompt: b) CH₃CH₂COOH, CH₃CCl₂COOH aur CH₃CHClCOOH ko strength (taqat) ke order mein likhein, sab se strong pehle.
blocks.explanation: CH₃CCl₂COOH > CH₃CHClCOOH > CH₃CH₂COOH. COOH ke saath wale carbon par jitne zyada Cl, utna zyada –I effect aur utna strong acid.

blocks.prompt: c) Samjhayein ke ethanoic acid ethanol se strong acid kyun hai.
blocks.explanation: Ethanoate ion mein negative charge do oxygen atoms par phaila hua hai; ethoxide ion mein yeh aik oxygen par rehta hai aur ethyl group ka +I effect use aur barhata hai. Ethanoate kaheen zyada stable hai, is liye ethanoic acid zyada ionize hota hai.

items: Acidity: carboxylic acids > phenols > paani > alcohols.
Ethanoate ion mein charge dono oxygens par phail jata hai, is liye stable.
+I groups acid ko weak, –I groups (Cl) strong karte hain; HCOOH > CH₃COOH; Cl₃CCOOH sab se strong.
